description: This Java source file defines a final class ModifyAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl that provides a builder pattern implementation for creating responses and events related to a ModifyAttributesLiveCommand in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It features nested classes for response and event factories, and methods for generating different types of responses and events associated with modifying attributes of a 'thing' entity.
